cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be the pouring supervisor. You choose the cups.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You inspect my hands before I pour. I'll write you an inspector's permit.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 takes supervisor role and gives B cup choice; A5 yields inspection of A own hands to maintain cooperation while adding a permit layer.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 issuer question creates supervisor; B4 supervisor spill creates inspection before pouring.
